note: The authors redescribe the species from Kemner's type material held at Lund University (lectotype soldier, lectotype alate, pseudergate) and check each character against Kemner 1932's original measurements; statements marked 'vide Kemner, 1932' in the source are earlier records. The pseudergate is treated here in a section of its own, placed under 'Other'.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Kemner 1932 described the species from specimens from Peradeniya, Ceylon, and the type series is now at Lund University, Sweden, comprising a lectotype soldier, a lectotype alate (dealated and broken in two) and one pseudergate. The soldier body length is 4.1—5.1 mm and that of the pseudergate about 4.0 mm, both small for the genus; the alate head width is 0.85 mm and the head length to the base of the mandibles 0.80 mm, and the pronotum has a maximum width of 0.73 mm (Kemner recorded 0.76 mm) and a maximum length of 0.49 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule, mandibles, thorax (including the wing scales) and abdomen dark brown; labrum and antennae brownish yellow; clypeus yellow; eyes black; head and body sparsely hairy. Head oval, longer including the eyes than wide; head capsule nearly circular, wider including the eyes than long to the base of the mandibles (width 0.85 mm, length 0.80 mm); sides slightly convex, slightly narrowed posteriorly; posterior margin rounded. Fontanelle absent. Eyes lateral, black, faceted, oval (maximum diameter 0.25 mm, minimum diameter 0.20 mm). Ocelli lateral, oval, 0.09 mm long and 0.07 mm wide, touching the eyes. Antennae incomplete (right antenna with 3 segments, left with 7); segment 1 long and cylindrical, segment 2 longer than half of segment 1, segment 3 about equal to segment 2, segments 4—7 about equal, broadly pyriform and longer than segment 3. Clypeus nearly trapezoidal, the limit between postclypeus and anteclypeus indistinct; anteclypeus white and hairless with a straight anterior margin; postclypeus with sparse hairs and a slightly convex anterior margin. Labrum nearly square, wider than long, sides slightly convex, anterior margin rounded and slightly incurved medially, with 5 pairs of hairs on the margin and 1 pair on the ventral face. Mandibles not examined. Pronotum nearly rectangular, much wider than long (maximum width 0.73 mm, maximum length 0.49 mm), the anterolateral corners narrower than the posterolateral ones, anterior margin concave with a slight median notch, sides slightly convex and narrowing posteriorly, posterior margin convex with a weak median notch. Posterior margins of mesonotum and metanotum slightly incurved medially. Legs damaged. Wing scales only: forewing scale large and shield-shaped, covering more than half of the hindwing scale; hindwing scale short and triangular. Abdomen long-oval and hairy; cerci 2-segmented, short, 0.05 mm long, partly concealed by tergite 9; styli absent.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brownish yellow, reddish brown in front; antennae, labrum and legs slightly paler than the head capsule; mandibles black; pronotum brownish yellow, slightly darker than the posterior part of the head, the anterior margin darker still; body pale brownish yellow; head and body with hairs of moderate density. Body length 4.1—5.1 mm. Head capsule rectangular-cylindrical and flattened; length to the base of the mandibles 1.50 mm (Kemner 1932 recorded 1.16—1.38 mm excluding the mandibles); head width 0.90 mm (Kemner recorded 0.74—0.92 mm); frontal angles without projections; frons sloping forwards, slightly depressed medially; the rest of the head of even height; sides parallel; posterior margin rounded; anterolateral corners of the head capsule, at the mandibular bases, rounded; Y-suture present. Fontanelle absent. Eyes represented by two small oval eye spots, maximum diameter 0.07 mm. Ocelli extremely small, barely discernible. Left antenna 11-segmented; segment 1 longest and cylindrical, segment 2 about half of segment 1, segment 3 shortest, segment 4 longer and wider than segment 3, segments 5 to the penultimate about equal and pyriform, apical segment oval and narrower than the penultimate. Clypeus nearly trapezoidal, divided into postclypeus and anteclypeus; anteclypeus thin, narrow, hairless and band-like; postclypeus hairy, coloured like the frons and separated from it by a shallow groove. Labrum wider than long, slightly narrowed forwards to a broadly rounded anterior margin, with several hairs near the margin. Mandibles short and stout, strongly incurved at the apex, with a weak basal swelling; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth (Kemner recorded 2), right mandible with 2 marginal teeth of equal size. Gula long and club-shaped; widest at the anterior quarter, narrowing posteriorly into a slender waist and slightly narrowed again in front; sides abruptly flaring near the posterior margin; anterior margin straight, posterior margin concave with a median swelling. Pronotum nearly rectangular, wider than long, slightly wider than the head capsule (Kemner recorded it as equal to or slightly narrower than the head); length 0.60 mm (Kemner recorded 0.42—0.44 mm), width 0.93 mm (Kemner recorded 0.70—0.81 mm); anterior margin broadly concave with a weak median notch, sides nearly straight and slightly narrowing posteriorly, posterior margin slightly convex with a slight median incurving. Mesonotum narrower, metanotum as wide as the pronotum, both with convex posterior margins slightly incurved medially. Legs short and stout, tibiae with 3 apical spines, tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen long-oval and hairy; last tergite rather strongly sclerotized; cerci 2-segmented, 0.09 mm long; styli one-segmented, 0.07 mm long.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Pseudergate: head pale brownish yellow, slightly paler in front; antennae, legs and body still paler; mandibles brownish yellow with dark brown tooth edges; head and body with hairs of moderate density; body length about 4.0 mm. Head oval, head capsule nearly circular and slightly wider than long (length to the base of the mandibles 0.73 mm, maximum width 0.77 mm); posterior margin rounded. Fontanelle and ocelli absent. Eyes represented by two barely discernible lateral eye spots, 0.1 mm in diameter. Antennae 9-segmented; segment 1 longest and cylindrical; segment 2 longer than half of segment 1 and cylindrical; segment 3 shorter than or about equal to segment 2 and subdivided; segments 4—8 progressively longer and pyriform; apical segment oval, narrower than and about equal to the penultimate. Clypeus nearly trapezoidal with a nearly convex anterior margin; anteclypeus transparent and hairless; postclypeus hairy and convex in front. Labrum nearly square, sides slightly convex, anterior margin slightly incurved medially. Mandibles of the typical Glyptotermes type, nearly square.
